probes.text: Hank, laid up at home after his injury, has taken up collecting and cataloguing minerals.
A visibly paranoid Saul has hired himself a personal bodyguard and keeps him nearby.
Walt and Jesse are being held in the lab under guard by Victor and Mike.
Jesse has bought a huge new stereo system, and the party at his house just keeps going.
Hank does his physical therapy sessions at home, and Marie is finding him hard to live with.
Andrea stops by Jesse's chaotic house out of concern, and he presses a thick stack of cash on her for Brock.
Jesse tosses piles of money into the chaos of a nonstop drug-fueled party at his house.
Skyler makes Walt rehearse over and over how he admits his gambling problem.
Walt and Skyler plan to explain the car wash and medical bills as gambling winnings.
Mike drives Jesse around New Mexico, bringing him along for a series of routine collections.
Walt and Skyler sit together signing the final papers to officially purchase the car wash.
Mike calmly assures a worried Walt that Jesse is safe while working with him.
Walt gives in to Walt Jr.'s pleas and buys him a brand new Dodge Challenger.
Skyler argues with Walt at home, demanding he return Walt Jr.'s flashy new sports car.
Walt drives the Challenger to a parking lot and takes it on a reckless joyride.
Skyler is taken aback by how much money Walt is making and worries about laundering it through the car wash.
Skyler climbs down into the crawl space beneath her house where Walt's cash is stored.
Ted is driving around town these days in a flashy newly leased Mercedes.
Walt sits alone inside his barricaded house in silence, keeping every door locked shut against visitors.
Skyler, Walt Jr., and Holly are staying with Hank and Marie at their house.
